Legal Aid BC is in the early stages of, and committed to a transformative journey to embedding Truth and Reconciliation, and Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion in all aspects of our work. We seek talent from equity-seeking groups, including but not limited to individuals who self-identify as First Nations, Inuit, or Métis descent, persons with disabilities, gender diverse, racialized, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community be a part of this exciting stage of Legal Aid BC’s growth. We care deeply about the culture we are building and are looking for staff members who not only excel in their respective areas but are also passionate about supporting the people we serve and each other. If this resonates with you, we encourage you to apply. All interested and eligible applicants will be considered with due consideration to all protected grounds under the BC Human Rights Code. If we can do anything to make your application experience a positive and equitable one, we want to hear from you on what we can do better.

PRIMARY FUNCTION:

To coordinate for the Legal Operations Division operational planning and analysis, including strategic risk management, project coordination, reporting, change management and performance measurement. This position gathers data and conducts analysis, performs research, and gives recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. This includes the facilitation of workshops, creative problem solving and project work.

The following job duties are illustrative examples and shall not be construed as an exhaustive description of all the work requirements that may be inherent in the job.

VALUES STATEMENT:

Our commitment to the principles of fundamental justice embedded in the Charter of Rights and Freedoms, and to Truth and Reconciliation, and Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion is ambitious and foundational. It informs everything we do, as we defend liberty, equality, autonomy, and dignity; as we dismantle colonization, racism, sexism, ableism, transphobia and homophobia, and all discrimination. These are our values, and they inform our hiring practices too. Our business is aiding people in severe legal distress and necessitates internal and external alignment of practicing these values. Integrating Truth and Reconciliation and Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion throughout every aspect of Legal Aid BC is critical to building that culture, and we prioritize ongoing resources to achieve that goal.

DUTIES:

1.SUPPORT THE STRATEGIC INITIATIVES OF THE LEGAL OPERATIONS DIVISION THROUGH PLANNING, ANALYSIS AND ASSESSMENT:

Review and recommend the development and maintenance of common operational definitions, key performance indicators, data dictionaries, reporting inventories, and documentation that improve consistency and confidence in Legal Operations reporting.
Analyze service volumes, workflow trends, resource utilization, demand patterns, turnaround times, productivity indicators, and other operational measures to identify risks, opportunities, and practical improvement options for management consideration.
Apply statistical analysis, forecasting, and data modelling techniques to interpret operational trends, support scenario analysis, and provide evidence-informed recommendations for business and service planning decisions.
Act as a functional bridge between Legal Operations and the Data and Analytics team, ensuring operational priorities, service delivery questions, and management reporting needs are translated into clear analytical, reporting, and technical requirements. Work with IT to ensure system performance and maintenance needs are met.
Consult with internal stakeholders on strategic risks and opportunities, planned and horizon activities, resource and capacity requirements;
Coordinate and facilitate strategic and operational planning workshops;
Support the various functions within the Legal Operations Division on their day-to-day operations, including schedule management, streamlining information flow (including information to and from the Manager), and communicating with various departments.
Review and recommend cross-departmental and cross-divisional initiatives in collaboration with other team members, ensuring timely and successful execution of such initiatives.
Attends meetings with the Manager (as may be required) and occasionally (if required) as a proxy, to ensure cross-divisional work is being done effectively.
Assists the Manager in meeting deadlines and assessing risk, cost and work required to implement new policies and procedures, then facilitate and support in connection with their completion.
Make recommendations in planning and creating new systems and providing an overall picture of productivity to various audiences, including executives.
Assist in the development and improvement of information, data collection, reporting, and research processes.
Identify issues and support in maintaining systems.
Coordinate assessments and evaluations as required for various Operations programs and initiatives.

Elicit, analyze, document, and verify business, functional, and technical requirements.
Coordinate assessment of current operational workflows and recommend improvements to increase efficiency and reduce costs.
Identify opportunities for business cases, issue papers, system specifications and standards changes and assists in execution of each.
Map, analyze, and optimize business workflows to create a repeatable, efficient, and visual structure, utilizing automation tools when appropriate
Work with existing LABC systems to identify needs for Legal Operations departments.

2. PROVIDE PROJECT MANAGEMENT AND CHANGE MANAGEMENT:

Review and make recommendations for the successful execution and delivery of projects by preparing project requests, obtaining approvals, monitoring progress and coordinating divisional activities.
Review and develop processes and tools to assess resource requirements, and monitor and forecast resource utilization, in alignment with society’s strategic and operational planning, project management, and decision-making processes for Legal Operations;
Support the Manager to maintain a prioritization tool for projects and initiatives. Remain up to date on all ongoing competing priorities to be able to do so;
Ensure LABC executes project activities in accordance with LABC policies, means, methods and constraints;
Provide technical support for project development and implementation, including review and coordination of project documentation, coordination of budgets with Finance, and participation on project teams as assigned;
Provide change-management support for LABC initiatives as assigned;
Assist in the preparation of project-related reports and long-range planning documents as assigned; and
Present status reports to Managers and Directors as required

3. COORDINATE AND PROVIDE SUPPORT FOR OPERATIONAL AND STRATEGIC PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENT AND SUPPORT EVIDENCE-BASED DECISION-MAKING:

Support managers and staff in the development, implementation and use of performance measures, including key indicators;
Track, monitor and facilitate the reporting of performance measures;
Identify emerging performance measures to update key metrics as necessary; and
Review evaluation, survey, and data and make suggestions in response to performance data and to incorporate into planning and decision-making processes

4. PROVIDE RISK MANAGEMENT AND INFORMATION MANAGEMENT SUPPORT:

Support the Manager to incorporate risk analysis into strategic and operational planning;
Assess and recommend enhancements to Legal Operations' information management strategies to support effective development and implementation; and
Review and aid in the development and maintenance of the records management system for the Legal Operations division

5. PERFORM OTHER RELATED DUTIES:

Assist the Manager in supporting effective organizational governance for the Legal Operations division;

Research, learn, and implement new opportunities that leverage technology to maximize productivity;

Document procedures related to the planning, project management, risk management, knowledge management, and LABC decision-making; and

Perform other duties as required.

Maintains strict confidentiality and safeguards all physical assets, operational data, and proprietary information, ensuring secure handling, storage, and communication across all Operations department division functions.

location: Amarillo, TX, US; Claude, TX, US
description:
SummaryThe Site Mechanical Superintendent for Data Center Construction helps oversee mission-critical field activities across multiple trade groups. This role focuses on high-speed, high-density Hyperscale and Colocation environments, optimizing resource allocation and manpower for complex mechanical systems. You will provide full support to the Project Director, Project Managers and the General Superintendent to ensure all construction complies with rigorous technical drawings, BIM/VDC specifications, and aggressive "speed-to-market" schedules.
Responsibilities

Safety Leadership & OSHA Compliance: Maintain a "safety-first" culture by enforcing OSHA standards and site-specific safety plans. Conduct regular audits to mitigate risks associated with energized environments and overhead work.
Mission-Critical Oversight: Lead field progress across multiple data hall build-outs; act as the primary liaison between the Project Director, Project Managers, General Superintendent and Field Foremen to ensure mechanical installations meet Tier-rated specifications for Hyperscale and Colocation facilities.
BIM & VDC Integration: Utilize Navisworks and Bluebeam to review coordinated models. Ensure field installations match the BIM coordination to avoid spatial conflicts in congested overhead galleries.
Level 1-5 Commissioning (Cx): Lead the mechanical field team through the full commissioning cycle. Oversee equipment start-ups and ensure all documentation—including hydrostatic test logs and duct leakage reports—is meticulously prepared for Level 4 (Functional Performance Testing) and Level 5 (Integrated Systems Testing).
Precision Resource Coordination: Allocate manpower and specialized equipment (e.g., heavy rigging for modular cooling units) across projects. Serve as the central material coordinator to ensure "just-in-time" delivery.
Quality & QMS Compliance: Review QA manuals as they relate to high-performance systems. Monitor craft productivity and adherence to strict "White Space" protocols.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Certification: OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety and Health certification is strictly required.
Specialized Expertise: Deep knowledge of Plumbing, Sheet Metal/HVAC, and General Construction specifically within Hyperscale (e.g., Google, AWS, Meta) or Colocation (e.g., Equinix, Digital Realty) environments.
Software Proficiency: Practical experience using Navisworks for clash detection review and Procore or similar for field documentation.
Commissioning Knowledge: Proven experience navigating the Level 1-5 Commissioning process for mission-critical cooling systems.
Leadership: Proven management experience leading multiple trade groups and an ability to evaluate employee work habits in high-pressure environments.

Employment Requirements

title: Azure Software Engineer
description:
Azure Software Engineer
Department: Technology
Location: Remote
FLSA Status: Exempt
People Leader: No
Travel: Less than 10%
Summary
Company Summary
Accuity partners with hospitals and health systems through a technology-enabled, physician-led model that improves clinical documentation integrity, coding accuracy, reimbursement optimization, and quality outcomes.
Job Summary
The Azure Software Engineer owns the engineering, operation, and reliability of Accuity’s Azure application and data services, including the functions, integrations, health data services, and database platforms that Accuity’s products depend on. Reporting to the Vice President, Data Architecture, this is a deep, hands-on engineering role at the center of Accuity’s cloud environment.
The role is accountable for how those services behave in production, including availability, resilience, performance, and cost. It leads root cause analysis and durable remediation for Azure platform incidents, maintains and tests disaster recovery and failover procedures, and keeps provisioned capacity matched to actual workload as systems change.
The Azure Software Engineer is the primary technical contributor to Accuity’s Azure engineering standards, which are owned by Data Architecture leadership and applied consistently across the environment. The role also leads Accuity’s move toward repeatable, code-defined provisioning as the company modernizes how cloud resources are deployed, and builds the documentation and automation that allow the environment to be operated, supported, and extended by more than one engineer.
Responsibilities
Azure Application and Data Services Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain Accuity’s Azure application and data services, including Azure Functions, APIs, integration and messaging services, and supporting components.
  • Own the engineering of Accuity’s health data and FHIR services, including ingestion, transformation, and integration with clinical and revenue cycle applications.
  • Build and maintain integrations with third-party clinical data platforms and interface partners.
  • Develop automation and tooling that reduces manual operation of the Azure environment.
  • Support application and data teams with Azure service design, implementation patterns, and troubleshooting.

Reliability, Performance, and Resilience

  • Own availability, performance, and resilience for the Azure services in scope, and be accountable for how they behave in production.
  • Lead root cause analysis and durable remediation for Azure platform incidents affecting production applications, rather than repeated manual recovery of the same failure.
  • Maintain, document, and test disaster recovery and failover procedures for owned services, including participation in scheduled tabletop and recovery exercises.
  • Design and tune for real load characteristics, including concurrency, contention, throughput, and latency under peak conditions.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability so service health is visible and issues are detected before users report them.
  • Define and maintain availability, recovery, and performance targets for owned services in partnership with Data Architecture leadership.

Cost, Capacity, and Resource Management

  • Own cost visibility for the Azure services in scope, and identify and execute optimization opportunities.
  • Right-size provisioned capacity as workloads change, including after migrations, cutovers, and service retirements, so the environment reflects actual demand rather than historical allocation.
  • Explain cost movement in owned services, including the drivers behind month-over-month variance.
  • Recommend service tier, SKU, and architecture changes that reduce cost without compromising reliability or compliance.
  • Support Azure consumption planning and forecasting in partnership with Data Architecture and Finance.

Standards, Provisioning, and Deployment Modernization

  • Serve as the primary technical contributor to Accuity’s Azure engineering standards, which are owned by Data Architecture leadership, covering resource provisioning, naming, tagging, environment separation, and lifecycle management.
  • Apply those standards consistently across the Azure estate, and bring existing resources into alignment over time.
  • Lead Accuity’s move toward repeatable, code-defined provisioning, evaluating infrastructure as code approaches and recommending how Accuity should deploy and manage cloud resources going forward.
  • Follow change management for production Azure resources, including documented approval, testing, and rollback planning.
  • Partner with Platform Management on shared deployment pipelines and environment capability rather than building parallel tooling.

Security and Compliance

  • Build and operate Azure services in accordance with HIPAA, HITRUST, and PHI protection requirements.
  • Apply least privilege to Azure resource access, identities, and service principals, and support periodic access reviews.
  • Implement encryption, network isolation, private connectivity, and auditing appropriate to the data handled.
  • Support audit readiness by producing accurate evidence of configuration, access, and controls for owned services.

Documentation and Operational Continuity

  • Document architecture, configuration, dependencies, runbooks, and recovery procedures for owned services to a standard that allows another engineer to operate and support them.
  • Eliminate undocumented manual steps by automating them or writing them down.
  • Cross-train engineers and share operational knowledge so no service depends on the availability of one person.
  • Keep documentation current as the environment changes rather than reconstructing it after the fact.

Collaboration

  • Partner with Data Architecture on the modernization of Accuity’s data platform, including migration sequencing, dependencies, and application impact.
  • Work with Engineering, Data Science and AI, Platform Management, and Enterprise IT on shared services, interfaces, and infrastructure.
  • Support Microsoft and vendor technical escalations for Azure services in coordination with technology leadership.
  • Communicate technical risk, options, and tradeoffs clearly, including where a recommendation carries cost, reliability, or compliance consequences.

Other Duties as Assigned

  • Perform additional responsibilities as needed to support technology operations and organizational goals.

Qualifications
Education and Credentials

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field preferred.
  • Equivalent professional experience, technical training, or a combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • Relevant Microsoft Azure certifications preferred.

Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on software or cloud engineering experience, including production ownership of Azure services.
  • Deep experience with Azure application services, including Azure Functions, APIs, integration services, and storage.
  • Experience with Azure database platforms such as SQL Managed Instance, including performance tuning under concurrency and contention.
  • Experience with health data standards and services such as FHIR and HL7 preferred.
  • Experience with disaster recovery design, failover testing, and production incident response.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and automated provisioning, or a demonstrated interest in adopting it.
  • Experience managing cloud cost and capacity in a production environment.
  • Experience in a regulated or security-sensitive environment, healthcare preferred.

Core Competencies

  • Hands-On Azure Depth: Brings deep, practical command of Azure services and uses it to solve real production problems rather than theoretical ones.
  • Production Ownership: Treats the behavior of a service in production as the measure of the work, including availability, performance, and cost.
  • Reliability Engineering: Designs for failure, tests recovery before it is needed, and fixes causes rather than symptoms.
  • Cost Consciousness: Understands what the environment costs and why, and keeps capacity matched to actual demand as systems change.
  • Standards Alignment: Works within shared standards and improves them through the agreed process rather than around it.
  • Collaborative Judgment: Brings a strong technical point of view, argues it well, and commits fully to the agreed direction once a decision is made.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Builds capability in others so that expertise scales beyond one person and the environment is never dependent on a single engineer.
  • Documentation Discipline: Records configuration, dependencies, and procedures as the work is done, to a standard someone else can follow.
  • Security Mindset: Treats access, isolation, and auditability as design requirements in a PHI environment rather than later additions.
  • Problem Solving: Diagnoses complex, ambiguous failures across application, data, network, and platform layers.
  • Adaptability: Adopts new approaches and tooling as the platform and the organization evolve.
  • Remote-Work Effectiveness: Communicates proactively, documents decisions, and maintains visibility into work in a fully remote organization.

Additional Requirements
1) Physical Requirements: The requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job with or without reasonable accommodations. Unless otherwise indicated, Accuity positions require interaction with people and technology while either sitting or standing. Employees must be able to communicate via phone, email, etc. and sit for extended periods of time, with or without reasonable accommodations. Physical effort and exposure to physical risk are limited to that of an office role / environment.
2) Position and Employment Statement: While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the job requirements, management reserves the right to modify, add or remove duties from a job and to assign other duties as necessary and at any time. All positions at Accuity Delivery Systems, LLC, are at-will employment, and a position description is not a guarantee of a job or of job responsibilities.

title: Universal Banker II
description:
Merchants Bank, Red Wing, is seeking a Universal Banker.

As a Universal Banker, you will be responsible for providing exceptional customer service and proactively offering a range of banking products and services to meet the financial needs of our customers. You will serve them with various banking and financial transactions, account inquiries, opening new deposit account relationships, consumer lending, and making product recommendations in an efficient and friendly manner.

Must have strong communication skills, comfortable with extensive customer contact, have sales experience, and a strong ability to multi-task and prioritize. Banking experience is a plus. This position may conduct administrative duties at the branch level.

This is a full time, 40 hours per week position, with shift hours of Monday-Friday 8:30am-4:30pm.

Merchants Bank offers competitive wages and benefits for our full-time employees including health, dental, life, disability and vision insurance; flexible spending accounts, 401(k) and ESOP retirement plans; bonus plan; paid time off; tuition reimbursement; and a variety of voluntary supplemental insurance options.

Please click on Apply Now or apply in person at Merchants Bank, Red Wing. Questions can be emailed to hr@merchantsbank.com. Merchants Bank is an Equal Opportunity Employer of women, minorities, protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Job Summary:
As a Universal Banker, you will be responsible for providing exceptional customer service and proactively offering a range of banking products and services to meet the financial needs of our customers. You will serve as a primary point of contact for customers, assisting them with various banking and financial transactions, account inquiries, opening new account relationships and safe deposit boxes, and making product recommendations in an efficient and friendly manner. The Universal Banker will play a crucial role in building customer relationships. You will also play an important role in fraud prevention.

Responsibilities and Skill requirements for each Universal Banker level:
Level I:

Open & maintenance basic checking and savings deposit accounts
Process banking transactions in the Teller area
Open, close and maintain safe deposit boxes
Serve as a Vault Attendant if needed in the Branch
If person is doing more than 50% Teller work, they may report to the Lead Teller and be considered in the Teller Department
Experience required: Relevant customer service experience; banking experience a plus
Education required: High school diploma or equivalent

Level II:

Be proficient in and conduct all Level I duties
Open & maintenance business accounts, IRAs, HSAs, CDs
Process banking transactions in the Teller area as needed
Community Engagement and External Sales Activity as directed.
Be proficient in Consumer Credit Card and ODP lending.
May conduct administrative duties at the branch level
May include Lead Teller duties
Experience required: A minimum of 6 months of front-line banking experience
Education required: High school diploma or equivalent

Responsibilities of all Universal Banker levels

Exceptional Customer Service:

Ensure that internal and external customers receive outstanding service from every employee (and speak up when they do not).

Be efficient and accurate when processing customer transactions, as outlined in current policies and procedures

Provide excellent customer service by greeting customers, seeking to understand their needs, and offering them personalized solutions.

Provide high-quality consultative conversations to uncover needs and opportunities.

Resolve customer issues and concerns promptly and effectively; escalate when needed.

Be proficient and happily able to assist customers on the systems including internet banking products, bill pay, e statements, mobile banking, telephone banking and anything else the customer may need assistance with.
Stay calm, professional and focused under pressure.

Relationship Building:

Build strong relationships with customers to understand their financial goals and identify opportunities to meet their needs.
Foster long-term customer loyalty through ongoing relationship management and exceptional service.
Build strong internal relationships with immediate coworkers as well as Merchants Bank employees in all shared services areas.

Sales and Business Development:

Meet or exceed individual sales targets for banking products (such as deposit accounts, loans and credit cards).
Conduct outbound sales activities (such as prospecting, lead generation, and follow-up on sales opportunities) as directed by supervisor.
Collaborate with other team members to achieve branch sales goals and contribute to overall business growth.

Respond to all customers inquires and forward any appropriate requests to other departments.
Promote bank products by answering inquires; inform customers of new services and product promotions.
Attend external customer meetings as requested.

Product Knowledge:

Maintain in-depth knowledge of the bank's products, services, and promotions.
Educate customers on the features, benefits, and terms of various banking products to help them make informed decisions.
Stay updated on industry trends, regulatory changes, and competitive offerings to provide accurate and up-to-date information to customers.

Compliance and Risk Management:

Complete all required compliance training and certifications on time to maintain a comprehensive understanding of compliance requirements.

Collect Privacy Codes/Security word as well as update email addresses and contact numbers.
Process transactions efficiently and accurately, ensuring compliance with internal policies, procedures, controls, and banking regulations.

Follow all bank policies, procedures, and regulatory guidelines to ensure compliance and mitigate risk.
Adhere to security and fraud prevention measures to safeguard customer information and bank assets.
Disseminate information regarding legal and fraud issues, to protect customers and retailers against fraud.

Operations:

Perform various administrative and operational tasks when opening and closing accounts, account maintenance and changes, and documentation. Follow maintenance and closed account procedures for all types of deposit accounts.
Update central file information when working with account portfolios & compliance regulated forms.

Accurately submit customer workflow/task requests as required in the appropriate systems.
Review the daily overdraft report to proactively catch your customers before they default.

Comply with any and all audit regulations concerning the security of your work area and branch location.
When working in the Teller area, process financial transactions including receiving deposits and loan payments, cashing checks, issuing withdrawals, recording night deposits, selling cashier's checks and money orders as well as answering customer questions. Maintain a balanced cash drawer and maintain an accurate supply of cash and coin.
Organize time to complete duties without sacrificing service to customers.
Maintain a neat and organized work area
Performs all other duties, as assigned, to increase performance of Merchants.
Accept request to cross-train for additional duties.

Teamwork/Relationships:

This position will report directly to Universal Banking Manager or Retail Banking Manager (depending on market) with performance and direction engagement from the Market President.
Collaborate with other team members to ensure branch operations run smoothly and efficiently.

Respond to supervisory guidance and direction, ask good questions, listen and do the appropriate detective work to either help yourself or our customers.

Active and willing to work at trade shows, promotional events, and marketing activities during work ours and on evenings and weekends as requested.

Participate in community activities to actively promote the bank.

Contribute to a positive working environment through words and actions.

Avoid personal phone calls, text messages, and non-business related emails (internal and external), and internet usage (unless in an urgent situation).

Regular and dependable on-time attendance is an essential function of the job.

Physical Working Conditions:
Climate-controlled inside working environment with low noise level. No environmental hazards or chemicals. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and stand; must occasionally lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. This position requires extensive work on a computer system.

Experience and Skill Requirements:

Banking experience is a plus for Level I, and required for Levels II & III
High degree of tact and professionalism
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Strong customer service skills and experience.
Demonstrated success working onsite and adhering to a work schedule
Flexibility to work varied shifts and hours (including Saturdays).
Demonstrated success handling difficult customer situations.
Demonstrated ability to stop, pause and speak up when concerned about a coworker’s or customer’s behavior.
Ability to use intuition and common sense to carry out instructions, understand procedures, speak professionally and clearly to customers and employees as well as to escalate to supervisor when needed.
Strong time management skills and the ability to multi-task and prioritize.
Strong math skills and abilities.
Cash handling experience desired
Strong computer system proficiency.
Ability to learn and follow established regulatory and compliance guidelines, policies and procedures.

Strong attention to detail.

A genuine desire to have engaging conversations with customers to identify and solve customer needs, as well as to offer additional appropriate products and service solutions

title: Lighting Design Intern/Co-op Summer 2027 - Energy Solutions
description:
CMTA is one of the fastest growing engineering firms in the U.S. with nationally recognized expertise in sustainable, high-performance building engineering. We are a collaborative, competitive, innovative, and energetic group of engineers and team leaders who incorporate a holistic approach towards consulting engineering, performance contracting, and zero energy projects. We focus on finding engineers whose personalities lead them to excellence, and we provide exceptional opportunities for our employees.
The core business of our Energy Solutions division is the delivery of Guaranteed Energy Savings Performance Contracts (ESPCs). Simply put, our ESPCs are a viable way to upgrade and renovate facilities in a budget-neutral or even budget-positive way. The process diverts money already being spent on utilities and directs it into facility upgrades, covering scope development, design, bidding, construction management, commissioning, measurement and verification, and even ongoing energy management services. We have experience in designing the nation’s most energy efficient buildings, including many zero energy buildings. Our knowledge is unparalleled in the Guaranteed ESPC market, which allows us to dive deeper than our competitors. CMTA Energy Solutions has a robust co-op program for college students pursuing a degree in engineering. We offer an immersive experience in the world of Guaranteed Energy Savings Performance Contracting for one or more semesters. Our co-ops build competitive industry skills in a hands-on environment through collaborative project tasks with full-time engineers while under the direct supervision of Professional Engineers. Our program is designed to develop students into full-time caliber employees that contribute to the company’s growth. The ideal candidate will possess excellent interpersonal skills and will be able to work well both as a team member and independently. Our program stands apart from the typical, rehearsed co-op rotation in which every co-op gains the same experience because it is designed for co-ops to stand out and take on challenging projects. Co-ops will be involved with multiple Guaranteed Energy Savings Performance Contracts and will have a role in every stage of their development. Each stage offers a variety of valuable experiences, from initial development through implementation. Whether co-ops are interested in building their skill set in identifying and calculating energy savings measures, developing renovation documents, or hands-on field experience, CMTA Energy Solutions is bound to overcome expectations. Lighting Co-ops can expect to get hands on experience with commercial lighting systems.
By the end of the program co-ops will have gained the experience to be able to deliver a full LED lighting upgrade design from scratch. Our Lighting co-op will directly support our lighting project managers. Job Functions: (may include but are not limited to)

  • Assist in all aspects of the project development phase – including site visits, building audits
  • Energy calculations in relation to lighting upgrades
  • Produce detailed construction documents using CAD for LED lighting upgrades
  • Support material procurement and construction management staff during implementation of lighting upgrades
  • Field verify proper installation and implementation of LED lighting upgrades

Requirements:

  • Pursuing a BSEE, preferably a sophomore (2nd year), or junior (3rd year),
  • CAD experience is helpful but not required
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel
  • Ability to work both independently and as a team member and
  • Ability to travel for field work.

Youth Orchestra Los Angeles (YOLA)

Program Summary

YOLA (Youth Orchestra Los Angeles) is LA Phil's signature education program, inspired by El Sistema and led by Gustavo Dudamel. YOLA provides over 1,500 students annually with access to instruments, high-quality music instruction, and holistic support, helping young people thrive artistically, socially, and academically at no cost.

YOLA provides transformational and equitable access to music education for young people from underserved communities, supporting their personal development, their communities, and beyond. The work of YOLA is focused on two areas:

Local programs which directly serve communities across Los Angeles

National programs which provide opportunities for young musicians, teaching artists, program administrators, and other stakeholders to learn from and create community with one another

Position Summary

The Program Assistant is a key member of the YOLA team, responsible for supporting the day-to-day operations of the assigned site. This role ensures smooth delivery of rehearsals, classes, performances, and student support services by coordinating logistics, maintaining communication between staff, students, and families, and aligning site operations with YOLA's values of access, inclusion, and artistic excellence.

The Program Assistant works closely with the Program Manager and site staff, as well as Teaching Artists, administrative staff, and LA Phil leadership to sustain a welcoming, safe, and efficient environment for students and families. This position requires regular evening and weekend availability in alignment with YOLA's programming schedule.

Key Responsibilities

Support the daily operations of the assigned YOLA site, ensuring rehearsals, classes, and events run smoothly and on schedule.

Serve as a primary point of contact for students, families, and teaching staff, responding to inquiries and supporting needs in a timely, professional manner.

Manage attendance systems, student records, and program data in alignment with YOLA-wide protocols.

Assist with the preparation and distribution of schedules, communications, and program updates to families and staff.

Coordinate site logistics such as space setup, equipment and instrument needs, transportation, meals, and safety procedures.

Support the planning and execution of concerts, community events, and cultural celebrations at the site.

Work collaboratively with site staff and faculty to maintain a safe, inclusive, and culturally responsive environment.

Monitor student participation and support strategies for engagement, mentorship, and holistic development.

Collaborate with the LA Phil Learning team on cross-site initiatives, special projects, and reporting.

Maintain accurate records of expenses, assist with budget tracking, and support procurement processes.

Proactively recommend improvements to site processes and family engagement strategies.

Uphold YOLA values and Code of Conduct in all interactions with students, staff, and families.

Evaluation & Professional Growth

Set and track individualized goals in alignment with evaluations and professional growth plans.

Participate in staff meetings, cross-site collaborations, and professional development opportunities.

Engage in reflective practice and incorporate feedback from supervisors, peers, students, and families.

Mandated Reporter & Code of Conduct

YOLA Program Assistants are caretakers of minors and are legally designated as mandated reporters under California law. As such, the following responsibilities and values are required:

Report any suspicion of child abuse or neglect to the appropriate authorities.

Maintain healthy personal and professional boundaries with all students and staff.

Remain attentive to signs of stress in oneself and others to foster a safe and supportive learning environment.

Seek guidance from senior staff when uncertain about professional boundaries or safety concerns.

Shared YOLA Values

Self-Respect and Respect for Community

Safety (for Self and Community)

Curiosity

Inclusion

Collaboration

Creativity

Bachelor's degree in education, arts administration, music, or related field, or equivalent professional experience

Minimum 2 years of experience in program coordination, youth development, arts education, or related fields

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with students, families, and colleagues

Experience working with youth and families from diverse racial, cultural, economic, and linguistic backgrounds

Commitment to equity, inclusion, and continuous improvement in program delivery

Strong technical skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Suite, and program management platforms (experience with Salesforce or Monday.com a plus)

Availability to work evenings and weekends as required by YOLA's programming schedule

title: Printing Supervisor
description:
Job Summary
The Wet End Operations Supervisor leads a high-performance team–consisting of two operations teams working alternating, rotating shifts–responsible for the critical early-stage chemical and printing processes that form the foundation of Kodak Alaris’ thermal media donor. This role ensures safe, efficient, and precise execution of Wet End operations—including raw material receiving, chemical mixing, solution batching, printing, quality control, and equipment readiness—while driving continuous improvement, operational excellence, and team development. Additionally, the role will partner with Supply Chain, Quality, Maintenance, Technical, Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS), and Management teams to coordinate departmental efforts across the flow.
This is a hands-on, floor-engaged leadership role for a supervisor who thrives in a technical manufacturing environment, champions safety, and inspires teams to deliver exceptional quality and throughput.

Performance Dimensions and Tasks
Operational Leadership – Time Spent 25%
Direct, coordinate, and monitor daily Wet End production activities to meet safety, quality, cost, and output targets. Assign work, manage staffing levels, and ensure proper shift coverage across all Wet End processes. Maintain real time awareness of production status, equipment performance, and process deviations, taking corrective action as needed. Lead teams to help identify problematic quality defects or machine operating conditions and escalate significant issues appropriately.

People & Team Management & Development – Time Spent 25%
Lead, coach, and mentor two teams of operators fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous learning. Conduct performance evaluations, deliver feedback, and support employee development plans. Promote cross training to build a flexible, resilient workforce. Ensure staffing levels always support production demands through the fair and equitable scheduling of crew vacations. Manage personnel and team conflicts in a healthy and constructive manner. Oversee the area-specific training programs to ensure the teams have the knowledge and skills to perform.

Quality & Process Control – Time Spent 15%
Oversee adherence to strict process and product specifications for raw materials, chemical preparation and gravure printing operations. Partner with Quality and Technical teams to troubleshoot process issues and maintain product integrity. Review and validate production records, batch documentation, and process logs for accuracy and completeness. Lead investigations into quality excursions and oversee countermeasure corrective actions.

Communication & Coordination – Time Spent 15%
Partner with Supply Chain, EHS, Technical, Maintenance, and Management resources to schedule product changeovers and shutdowns and monitor real-time factors such as raw material, quality, or general flow constraints to
Generate plans to meet output goals. Communicate production status, issues, and priorities to cross functional teams and leadership. Participate in daily meetings, shift handoffs, and production planning sessions.

Safety & Compliance - Time Spent 10%
Enforce Kodak Alaris’ safety standards, environmental regulations, and chemical handling protocols. Conduct routine safety audits, lead incident investigations, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Ensure all team members are trained and certified in required safety procedures.

Continuous Improvement – Time Spent 10%
Identify opportunities to improve throughput, reduce waste, and enhance process stability. Champion Lean and 5S initiatives within the Wet End area. Collaborate with Technical and Maintenance teams to optimize equipment reliability and reduce downtime. Ensure operations resources are available for shutdown cleaning and project support work.

description:
About the Job

We are looking for a dynamic and analytical Director of Training, Quality, and Compliance to spearhead strategies for agent performance, customer experience, and compliance.

Additionally, the position involves implementing strategies during New Hire Training to reduce agent attrition.

As Director of Training, Quality, and Compliance, You Will…

Align all training programs and QA scorecards with critical call center metrics, including First Contact Resolution (FCR), Average Handle Time (AHT), Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), Net Promoter Score (NPS), and Net Quality Scores.

Analyze customer interaction trends and QA insights to identify individual and systemic coaching opportunities. Feed these findings directly back into the training team to rapidly close performance gaps.

Oversee curriculum development for new-hire nesting programs, technical/product training, soft-skills coaching, and cross-channel service strategies (voice, chat, email).

Lead regular cross-functional calibration sessions with Operations, Compliance, and Team Leads to ensure objective and uniform grading criteria.

Guide the team in setting analytics structure for Survey/ KPI analysis to get the status of opportunities and the action plans to address those opportunities. Maximize the use of conversational AI, speech analytics, and automated quality monitoring tools to audit interactions at scale rather than relying solely on random sampling.

Build structured career pathways and leadership training for high-potential agents, Quality Analysts, and Team Leaders to foster internal talent retention.

Guide, mentor, and resource a team of Training Managers, Trainers, QA Supervisors, and Quality Assurance Specialists.

Manage both internal stakeholders and client stakeholders.

As Director of Training, Quality, and Compliance, You Need…

A Bachelor's degree.

13+ years of progressive management experience in a high-volume BPO or call center environment, including a minimum of 3 years in a director or senior leadership role managing both QA and training operations.

Expert-level understanding of call center dynamics and various learning principles.

Possession of formal QA certifications or knowledge of COPC and Lean Six Sigma is highly desirable.

Strong emotional intelligence, outstanding data analysis skills, and the leadership presence required to align operations team leaders toward shared quality objectives.

title: Minigrip - PROCESS CONTROL ENGINEER I
description:
TITLE: Process Control Engineer I

POSITION OBJECTIVE: Optimizes the production of current products through process improvements. Develops, coordinates, and manages process and equipment engineering projects to support introduction of new products, processes and equipment as well as machine and process upgrades. Four manufacturing processes: blown film extrusion, in-line printing, bag forming (conversion), and product packaging (cartoning) comprise the manufacturing area of responsibility. Provides support in a variety of management areas to ensure compliance with environmental regulatory standards, OSHA safety standards, American Sanitation Institute standards, housekeeping standards, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP’s), and CTPAT program standards for security.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent required, Engineering preferred
Experience with process engineering, equipment design and product engineering
Experience with blown film
Experience with project management and implementation
Must possess effective verbal and written communication skills
Working knowledge of general manufacturing and business principles
Willing and capable of domestic and international travel
Experience with plastic bag conversion, preferred
Experience with product packaging operations, preferred
Ensure consistent, dependable attendance and demonstrate a willingness to accommodate non-standard work hours as necessary.
Capable of effectively managing job-related stress and fostering productive workplace interactions.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Design and manage records of process improvements.
Manage and improve cost associated with the manufacturing processes. Focus should be improving all aspects of cost including yield, formulation, up time, and product quality.
Interact with sales, marketing, manufacturing, and maintenance to determine and develop product designs, product specifications, manufacturing methods, feasibility studies, and timeline for project completion.
Develop/write capital requests for project equipment or materials working with various vendors for best value, lowest cost.
Direct completion of active manufacturing and process related projects with particular emphasis on project objectives and achieving time & capital budget constraints.
Responsible for development, evaluation and implementation of new or improved manufacturing methods and/or processes.
Determine methods and/or upgrades that increase production capacity and machine efficiency thereby, reducing manufacturing costs.
Verify via reports that capital projects perform as projected.
Support manufacturing of current products by investigating and explaining the causes of scrap.
Interact with Technical Specialist(s) in activities that foster continuous improvement of current processes and, completion of active process and manufacturing improvement projects.
Actively participate as a member of the Safety Committee.
Provide resource information, participate in accident investigations, advise course of action to correct unsafe conditions, provide engineered designs as necessary to ensure compliance with OSHA regulations.
Provide project and process improvement status updates as required.
Perform other duties as requested by management.

Work closely with the rest of the team to deliver high-quality solutions and services.

Excellent working knowledge of ERP and SRP processes.
Great analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Strong written, verbal and presentation skills.
Strong use of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Ability to document complex requirements simply.

NetSuite certifications are beneficial but not essential.Experience with other software or ERP’s is also beneficial but not essential.

Multi-threaded programming and synchronization techniques
Concurrency vs. parallelism concepts
Threading, locks, race conditions, and deadlock prevention
Parallel algorithm design patterns and data pipelines
Asynchronous vs. synchronous programming models
Performance optimization for multi-core systems
Concurrency considerations in game engines and real-time applications

Create a student-centered, inclusive, and engaging learning environment that supports diverse learning styles
Guide students through hands-on implementation of:

Multi-threaded programs
Synchronization mechanisms (locks, mutexes, condition variables)
Parallel algorithms and design patterns
Concurrent systems used in game and real-time software development

Demonstrate best practices for:

Thread-safe code design
Debugging race conditions and deadlocks
Performance profiling and optimization
Cross-platform concurrency considerations
Provide structured, constructive feedback on assignments, midterm projects, and final projects

Model professional software development practices, including:

Code organization and documentation
Version control workflows
Maintainable and scalable system design

Uphold academic and attendance policies, including timely grading and accurate record keeping
Communicate effectively with students using approved communication platforms and provide timely academic support
Demonstrate an ongoing commitment to teaching excellence, reflective practice, and continuous professional development
Student Mentorship
Support students in developing a strong conceptual and practical understanding of concurrency and parallel processing
Encourage analytical thinking, problem decomposition, and performance-aware design

Chief Academic Officer
Program Director / Program Lead / Program Coordinator
Academic Advisors
Faculty
Students

Master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Game Programming, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience

Concurrency and parallel programming concepts
Multi-core an d multi-processor architectures

Game engines or real-time systems
Parallel algorithm design patterns

title: MTIPolyexe -  EXTRUSION TECHNICIAN C
description:
TITLE: Extrusion

POSITION OBJECTIVE: Extrusion Operators are critical members of our team. They set up, operate, and tend machines that extrude and coat flat films from synthetic materials. In this position you will set up and operate production equipment including blown film extruders, silicone coaters, and slitter/rewinders. You will work both independently and with a team to meet and exceed customers’ specifications and timeframes

QUALIFICATIONS:

Operation Monitoring — Ability to Watch gauges, dials, or other indicators to make sure a machine is working properly.
Operations — Ability to Control operations of equipment or systems.
Controls — The ability to adjust the controls of a machine or a vehicle to precise positions.
Able to work holidays and overtime when needed.
Be familiar with rulers, scales, gauges, and other measurement tools.
Eligible to work in the U.S
Ability to Detect Problem — The ability to tell when something is wrong or is likely to go wrong. It does not involve solving the problem, only recognizing there is a problem.
Problem Solving — Identifying problems and reviewing related information to troubleshoot or to alert supervisor.
Coordination — The ability of fingers of one or both hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble very small objects.
Ensure consistent, dependable attendance and demonstrate a willingness to accommodate non-standard work hours as necessary.
Capable of effectively managing job-related stress and fostering productive workplace interactions

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Adjust machine components to regulate speeds, pressures, and temperatures, and amounts, dimensions, and examine, measure, and weigh materials or products to verify conformance to standards, using measuring devices such as templates, micrometers, or scales.
Monitor machine operations and observe lights and gauges to detect malfunctions.
Clear jams and remove defective or substandard materials or products.
Notify supervisors when extruded filaments fail to meet standards.
Record and maintain production data, such as meter readings, and quantities, types, and dimensions of materials produced.
Review work orders, specifications, or instructions to determine materials, ingredients, procedures, components, settings, and adjustments for extruding, forming, pressing, or compacting machines.
Turn controls to adjust machine functions, such as regulating air pressure, creating vacuums, and adjusting coolant flow.
Clean dies, arbors, compression chambers, and molds, using swabs, sponges, or air hoses.
Synchronize speeds of sections of machines when producing products involving several steps or processes.
Move materials, supplies, components, and finished products between storage and work areas, using work aids such as racks, hoists, and hand trucks.
Activate machines to shape or form products, such as candy bars, light bulbs, balloons, or insulation panels.
Select and install machine components, such as dies, molds, and cutters, according to specifications, using hand tools and measuring devices.
Send product samples to lab for analysis.
Couple air and gas lines to machines to maintain plasticity of material and to regulate solidification of final products.
Pour, scoop, or dump specified ingredients, metal assemblies, or mixtures into sections of machine prior to starting machines.
Measure, mix, cut, shape, soften, and join materials and ingredients, such as powder, cornmeal, or rubber to prepare them for machine processing.
Remove materials or products from molds or from extruding, forming, pressing, or compacting machines, and stack or store them for additional processing.
Feed products into machines by hand or conveyor.
Measure arbors and dies to verify sizes specified on work tickets
Thread extruded strips through water tanks and hold-down bars or attach strands to wires and draw them through tubes.
Complete work tickets and place them with products.
Disassemble equipment to repair it or to replace parts, such as nozzles, punches, and filters.
Remove molds, mold components, and feeder tubes from machinery after production is complete.
Swab molds with solutions to prevent products from sticking.
Ignite burners to preheat products or use torches to apply heat.
Install, align, and adjust neck rings, press plungers, and feeder tubes.

OTHER INFORMATION:

Sign-on & Retention Bonus to $1,250
Relocation assistance up to $2500
Offers paid training for apprenticeships
After Offer is accepted, a background check and drug screen are required.

PHYSICAL ACTIVITY REQUIRED FOR THIS POSITION:

Able to stand, bend, squat, lift 30 pounds.

title: X-Ray Technologist (Medical Radiation Technologist) (Westhills)

title: AI & Data Business Analyst
description:
About the Job

We are changing the way people think about customer care, and we need your help!

We’re looking for an AI & Data Business Analyst to bridge the gap between business strategy, data analytics, and artificial intelligence. You will assist with performing User Acceptance Testing (UAT), the operationalization of business, process, and system changes, and driving data-driven decisions through dashboard creation and AI-powered insights across training curriculums, quality assurance, and reporting.

As AI & Data Business Analyst, You Will…

Collect and validate data requirements for business intelligence and AI systems.

Build, design, and maintain dynamic, executive-facing dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to support reporting and visualize data from multiple applications.

Identify AI opportunities and define business requirements to integrate Generative AI and machine learning solutions into existing operational workflows.

Create, validate, and recommend optimization of business processes using data-driven insights and AI capabilities.

Support projects through development, quality assurance, user acceptance testing (UAT), and production implementation for both traditional software and data/AI models.

Leverage AI tools and methodologies to discover patterns, clean large datasets, interpret anomalies, and automate repetitive data preparation tasks.

Create internal guides, training materials, and end-user documentation for new BI dashboards and AI features.

Facilitate requirements workshops to connect business leaders with AI, data, and technical development teams.

Build and manage business relationships, ensuring AI and data solutions solve real business problems, reduce operational costs, and generate measurable ROI.

As an AI & Data Business Analyst, You Need…

A Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or equivalent experience.

3-5 years of practical business/data analysis experience, with demonstrated experience in analyzing systems, creating structured business requirements documents (BRDs), and working with complex data.

AI fluency: a strong understanding of how generative AI and large language models (LLMs) work, and the ability to apply AI tools to accelerate analysis, forecasting, and reporting.

Dashboarding and visualization experience. Hands-on experience building user-friendly reports and visualizations using BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).

Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, joining, and business analysis. Familiarity with Python (Pandas, NumPy) or R for scalable analytics workflows is a strong asset.

Demonstrated experience creating and leading testing (UAT), including evaluating the accuracy and performance of AI solutions.

Business process management practitioner designation, CBAP, Lean Six Sigma (yellow or black), PMP, or AI/Data analytics certifications are considered an asset.

Experience facilitating workshops and training sessions with diverse groups of stakeholders to drive AI adoption and tech literacy.

Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational and time management skills.

Demonstrated strength in communications (both verbal and written), with the ability to translate complex numerical data and AI concepts into a clear narrative that drives action.

Strong problem-solving skills and comfort with ambiguity when defining the scope of new data or AI projects.

JOB TITLE: Project Manager

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY
The Project Manager is responsible for leading and delivering strategic projects and initiatives that support Accerta's business objectives and service commitments. This includes planning, coordinating, and implementing a range of operational, business, technology, and client-focused initiatives, such as program enhancements, process improvements, service delivery modernization, operational efficiency initiatives, system and workflow changes, organizational transformation projects, and the implementation of new products, services, or business capabilities.The Project Manager will work closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with organizational priorities, while also managing ongoing operational improvement initiatives and supporting continuous improvement across the organization.

ACCOUNTABILITIES

The Project Manager will be responsible for leading cross-functional projects from initiation through closure, ensuring successful delivery within scope, schedule, budget and quality objectives.
Drive project execution, manage risks and dependencies, facilitate stakeholder engagement, and provide timely reporting to leadership, ensuring projects align with Accerta’s strategic and operational objectives.
Lead the planning, execution, monitoring and closure of multiple concurrent projects, along with being responsible for requirements gathering and documentation, creation of test plans and execution of end-to-end testing cycle, updating system and process documentation, project-related communications/ training and transitioning knowledge when the project is complete.
In partnership with the project sponsor, create a project charter that defines objectives, a baseline scope, schedule and budget; support the development of business case documentation; develop measures of success; risks and assumptions; and resource requirements.
Ensure project outcomes align with approved business requirements and strategic priorities.
Adhere to Accerta PMO methodologies, standards and governance frameworks ensuring each project is channeled through the intake process, develop and maintain a tracking schedule and prioritize multiple projects underway to ensure critical milestones remain on track.
Track project performance metrics and provide visibility into schedule, budget, risks and outcomes.
Proactively identify and manage project risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies, escalating critical risks and decisions through appropriate governance channels. Develop and execute mitigation and contingency plans.
Lead the identification, analysis, and resolution of project issues using structured problem-solving methodologies and root cause analysis techniques.
Accountable for weekly project health reporting during PMO Portfolio Review meetings with Senior Leadership Team (SLT), providing accurate and timely updates on project status, including scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues, dependencies, resource constraints and key milestones.
Support SOW management, contract deliverables and project-related procurement activities.
Support change management activities related to internal and external project implementations.
Promote PMO best practices, standards and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ability to summarize and document lessons learned and complete steps for closing projects.
Ensure project planning, decision-making and delivery activities reflect Accerta's values as a certified B Corporation and social enterprise, balancing operational efficiency, stakeholder experience, accessibility, quality, compliance and responsible stewardship of public resources.
Other duties, as assigned.

Knowledge and Experience:

Bachelor’s Degree and/or PMP certification is required.
Preferred to have Scrum or any agile certification.
3 to 5 years progressive experience as a Project Manager or equivalent experience (knowledge of methodologies, tools and techniques for testing and developing business requirements).
Experience in project management in the public, insurance, or health sector is an asset.
Proficiency with Microsoft Suite such as MS Project, SharePoint, Word, Excel, Power Point and Visio.
Proficiency using technology tools such as SQL, DevOps, Balsamiq, Figma, ClickUp and JIRA.
Ability to apply frameworks and methodologies such as Agile and Scrum throughout a project’s lifecycle.
Planning, organizing, and executing multiple concurrent projects of medium to high complexity, delivering them within specified timeframes and budgets.

Excellent problem solving, presentations and interpersonal communication skills.
Must be extremely detail-oriented with respect to documentation and communication.
Coordinating with internal and external stakeholders i.e. clients, vendors, consultants, external partners and team members to set expectations, deliverables and objectives.
Demonstrated ability to manage projects within complex stakeholder environments where public interest, client experience, operational effectiveness and business objectives must be balanced.

Growth Opportunities: In a company that promotes from within.

title: Process Engineer
description:
About the company:
Viant is a global medical device partner providing design, development, manufacturing, and assembly services through capabilities in materials, plastics, metals, extrusion, and automation. About the role:
The Corporate Process Engineer is responsible for leading advanced process development across the full lifecycle of molding and manufacturing programs, applying expert scientific molding and cavity pressure control principles to deliver robust, optimized processes. This role provides hands-on technical leadership for tooling design, process validation (IQ, OQ, PQ), and DOE execution, while supporting NPI, sustaining engineering, and business development initiatives. The Principal Process Engineer serves as a key technical interface between Viant, customers, tool shops, and internal teams to ensure regulatory compliance and best-in-class production outcomes.

Work Model: Remote
Travel Requirement: 75% travel across Viant locations in the US but mainly to Costa Rica, Tijuana, BC, and Vega Baja, PR sites.

Lead the process development cycle
Evaluate processes for robustness, accuracy, and optimization
Initiate improvement projects
Quality/Metrology support: Assist site QE on KPI/KPO impacting part quality and process control
Partner with GTS/Site Tooling Engineer on design requirements
Partner with Tool Engineer on design and development requirements
Support business development by selling tooling solutions and resolving processing issues
Support corrective actions, re-validations, and tool/process optimization
Oversee process development through I.Q. and O.Q. runs; report required
Complete other related projects and tasks assigned
Demonstrate expert knowledge and performance
Apply scientific molding (Decoupled 2 and Decoupled 3)
Expert in cavity pressure monitoring and control (RJG)
Join technical reviews with customers and mold shops
Support DFM and tool design reviews with Tool Engineers
Support molding cell development and execution
Support EOAT design and fabrication
Manage mold shop deliverables and expectations (SIM reports)
Confirm receiving-site requirements (press/shot size/tonnage/special sequence) and machine capability studies
Develop processes, review Moldflow data for start-up and debug
Travel to customer sites, tool shops, and Viant facilities as needed; trip report required
Prepare, track, and communicate Process DOEs, report results and recommendations
Manage multiple concurrent projects (minimum 20 active)

Requirements:
Education:

Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering or related plastics discipline or 4-year engineering degree or equivalent completion of a 4,000 hour or 2-year process engineering apprenticeship.
Certification from a school in advanced molding or RJG Master Molder 2 (or equivalent).
Certification in Basic Mold Flow (or equivalent) is a plus.
Certification in Master Molding 3 is a plus.
Fully Bilingual (English & Spanish)

Years of Experience:

10+ years of experience in processing and in a molding environment, process development, qualification, validation of molds, etc.

Job Knowledge :

Extensive knowledge and able to train in: processing and process development techniques in scientific molding principles (MM2 skill level)
Plastics—Injection Molding; LSR (preferred)
Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and general computer skills; SolidWorks (drawing); 3D printing/3D software (preferred)
Some knowledge in FDA, QSR, and ISO 13485 medical device regulations and standards.
Understanding of statistics, Cp & Cpk studies for process. I.Q., O.Q. and P.Q. requirements
Strong understanding of DOE methods and implementation
Expert knowledge of cavity pressure technologies and advanced control principles
Familiarity with the various engineering grade thermoplastic resins and Mold Flow analysis."

Additional Requirements:

Authorized to work in the U.S.
Ability to travel up to 75% to Viant sites (U.S., Costa Rica, Tijuana, and Vega Baja, PR)

title: Tool Maker
description:

Learn more at Viant Medical’s website or on LinkedIn.

Our Fremont manufacturing facility specializes in clean room-based medical device assembly, including catheter manufacturing, supporting complex and high-precision production. As a Tool Maker you will perform advanced mold making, repair, and modification work with minimal supervision. You will support production and engineering by independently executing complex machining, troubleshooting mold performance issues, and mentoring junior team members. You will also operate a wide range of tool room equipment including CNC, EDM, and high‑precision manual machines to ensure high‑quality mold performance and adherence to customer specifications.

Responsibilities:

Manufacture new molds and components per customer specifications with minimal oversight.

Independently set up, program, and operate CNC machining centers, EDM sinkers, and WEDM equipment.
Create fixtures, jigs, and auxiliary tooling to support production needs.

Verify part accuracy using precision inspection equipment and techniques.
Ensure all work meets quality, dimensional, and functional requirements.
Participate in design reviews and kick‑off meetings, providing technical input to improve manufacturability.

title: Maintenance Tech III
description:
At M&M Industries, we take pride in producing high-quality plastic packaging solutions that make a difference in everyday life. Our success starts with the people who make it all happen — from production and maintenance to engineering and logistics.
The Maintenance Technician III is responsible for testing, troubleshooting, and repairing production equipment. This role inspects and maintains all plastic injection molding machines, associated equipment, and plant infrastructure to ensure safe, efficient, and reliable operation. The Maintenance Technician III plays a key role in reducing downtime, improving machine performance, and ensuring all equipment and facility standards remain in technical compliance.
Maintenance Technician Career Progression

Technician I – $31.37/hr
Technician II – $34.22/hr
Technician III – $36.00/hr
Technician IV – $41.00/hr

Placement is based on experience, technical knowledge, and demonstrated skills.

Key Responsibilities:

Follows all safety policies and procedures to ensure a safe working environment.
Draws sketches to clarify design details and functional criteria of mechanical systems.
Troubleshoots non-functioning components (e.g., servos, sensors, and control components).
Logs equipment usage, parts replacement, and scheduled maintenance to maximize functionality.
Identifies root causes of downtime, poor production performance, non-conforming product, and scrap.
Diagnoses, analyzes, and repairs electro-mechanical and instrumentation equipment using meters, gauges, and other testing methods.
Assembles experimental circuitry or prototype models according to engineering instructions, technical manuals, and system knowledge.
Recommends design or circuitry modifications to simplify assembly and maintenance.
Troubleshoots and repairs solid-state motor drives, temperature controllers, and computer-based controllers.
Analyzes and interprets data from drives, controllers, scope meters, and other diagnostic tools.
Adjusts, calibrates, and aligns circuitry and components and records performance outcomes.
Checks newly installed equipment to evaluate system performance under actual operating conditions.
Performs required preventive maintenance assignments and completes documentation accurately and on time.
Communicates safety, quality, and production concerns to team leaders and supervisors.
Maintains a clean and organized work environment in accordance with 5S principles.
Provides engineers with the necessary information for continuous improvement initiatives.
Identifies when equipment needs to be replaced and notifies the supervisor.
Prepares work areas to ensure tools and materials are available and in proper working order.
Assists in training new hires as required.

Competencies (Knowledge/Skills/Abilities):

Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Ability to perform IML (In-Mold Labeling) setup and troubleshooting.
Basic knowledge of heat transfer machine setup and troubleshooting.
Understanding of machines and tools, including their use, repair, and maintenance.
Knowledge of electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems and how they function.
Comprehensive understanding of Food Safety, GMP, PRP, and HACCP requirements as they relate to food-contact packaging (in applicable facilities).
Basic understanding of PLC programming and logic.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Education:

High School Diploma or G.E.D. (required)
Technical 2-year degree or equivalent combination of education and experience (preferred)

Experience:

Minimum 3 years of experience in Industrial Maintenance (required)
Minimum 2 years of experience related to electronics (preferred)

Ability to lift and carry 25–50 pounds frequently and assist with lifting more than 75 pounds occasionally.
Ability to perform work involving bending, stooping, stretching, and climbing ladders.
Work performed in a manufacturing environment that may be hot or cold and requires PPE at all times (safety glasses, hearing protection, etc.).
